 Projected Lineup: November 1 vs. Winnipeg
 Kochetkov earns fourth straight start as Canes host Jets
 By 
 Peter Dewar 
 Hurricanes.com 
 November 01, 2026 
 Link copied 
 RALEIGH, N.C. - Carrying a five-game point streak (4-0-1), the Carolina Hurricanes are keeping their lineup intact as they host the Winnipeg Jets for a Sunday matinee at Lenovo Center.
 Pyotr Kochetkov  will tend the twine for the fourth straight game. The Russian backstop is already the first goaltender in franchise history to start a season 9-0-0, and could become the third goaltender in NHL history to win his first 10 games of a campaign should he and his team emerge victorious this afternoon.
 Kochetkov was in net when the Canes and Jets squared off in Winnipeg on Oct. 17, turning in 21 saves on 23 shots to help his team to a 3-2 win.
 Ahead of him, the line of Logan Stankoven, Jackson Blake  and Nikolaj Ehlers  will aim to continue its recent dominance. Blake (2G, 5A) and Ehlers (3G, 4A) are both riding five-game point streaks, while Stankoven has five goals in his last five outings and leads the team in that category with nine on the year.
 ---
 Tonight's Projected Lineup...
 Forwards 
 Carrier - Aho - Svechnikov
 Ehlers - Stankoven - Blake
 Martinook - Jankowski - Jarvis
 Robinson - Kotkaniemi - Deslauriers
 Defense 
 Slavin - Chatfield
 Miller - Walker
 Gostisbehere - Välimäki
 Starting Goaltender 
 Kochetkov
 ---
 Injuries 
 Taylor Hall (Upper-Body Injury |"Out For A Little While" as of Oct. 27)
 Jordan Staal (Calf Tear | Expected To Be Out "A Month or Two" From Oct. 13)
 Scratches 
 Mike Reilly
 ---
 PP1: Aho, Blake, Ehlers, and Svechnikov with Gostisbehere
 PP2:  Jankowski, Jarvis, Kotkaniemi, and Stankoven, with Välimäki
